description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Sokka and Suki to trigger.
Resolve Sokka and Suki's second ability, creating a 1/1 white Ally creature token plus an additional artifact token through Tippy-Toe, which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis. Each relevant ability of Sokka and Suki triggers.
Resolve Sokka and Suki's first ability, attaching up to one Equipment to the Ally that triggered it.
Repeat from step 2.
